University Institute of Engineering and Technology
Panjab University, Sector-25, Chandigarh 160014
Project Staff Requirement
Applications are invited for the appointment of Project Technical Support-III in ICMR funded
project entitled “Tele-Health Screening and Management for Non-Communicable Diseases”
for a period of 1 year OR coterminous with project depending upon the satisfactory performance of
the candidate at University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET), Sector-25, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.

Responsibilities:
 Maintenance and deployment of Tele-Health equipment in field
 Cloud based Software deployment, maintenance and coordination
 Design and Development of e-content as per script prepared
 Maintaining data related to patients and consolidating the reports
 Coordination project related administrative activities
 Managing the use of research resources and ensuring effective use is made of them.
 Project may also involve frequent field travel to different states of India for project
implementation.
 Any other work as assigned by PI/Co-PI
The incumbent is expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and maybe on holidays also for any
project exigency. Date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible/
shortlisted candidates through email or phone. No separate call letters will be issued for the
interview. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview.
Candidates can apply within 7-days from date of advertisement through Google form Link
https://forms.gle/2ch3f22WtBi25paW8
Dr. Harish Kumar
